import numpy as np

def speculative_decode(draft_model, target_model, prompt, k=5):
    tokens = []
    # Draft generates k tokens
    draft_tokens = []
    current = prompt
    for _ in range(k):
        token = draft_model.generate(current)
        draft_tokens.append(token)
        current = current + [token]
    # Target verifies all k tokens in parallel
    target_probs = target_model.get_probs(prompt + draft_tokens)
    draft_probs = draft_model.get_probs(prompt + draft_tokens)
    # Accept/reject
    accepted = []
    for i in range(k):
        acceptance = min(1, target_probs[i][draft_tokens[i]] / (draft_probs[i][draft_tokens[i]] + 1e-10))
        if np.random.random() < acceptance:
            accepted.append(draft_tokens[i])
        else:
            accepted.append(np.argmax(target_probs[i]))
            break
    return accepted
